trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: 處於陽光下時，卓柏卡布拉的攻擊檢定具有劣勢，依賴視覺的感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定也具有劣勢。

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} 命中 {@hit 4}，觸及 5 呎，單一目標。{@h}7（{@damage 2d4 + 2}）穿刺傷害。若目標是生物，它必須成功通過一次 {@dc 13} 力量豁免檢定，否則被擊倒而{@condition prone||伏地}。

action.name: Drain Blood
entries: {@atk mw} 命中 {@hit 4}，觸及 5 呎，一個處於{@condition prone||伏地}、{@condition incapacitated||無力}或{@condition restrained||束縛}狀態的生物。{@h}5（{@damage 1d6 + 2}）死靈傷害。目標必須成功通過一次 {@dc 13} 體質豁免檢定，否則其生命值上限減少等同所受傷害的數值，卓柏卡布拉則恢復等量的生命值。此減少效應持續到目標完成一次長休為止。若此效應使目標的生命值上限降至 0，它便會死亡。

reaction.name: Pin
entries: 若卓柏卡布拉 5 呎內的一個生物起身，卓柏卡布拉可以用反應進行一次啃咬攻擊。

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: 若上古恐龍豁免檢定失敗，它可以選擇改為成功。

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: 上古恐龍對抗法術與其他魔法效應的豁免檢定具有優勢。

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: 上古恐龍對物件與建築造成雙倍傷害。

trait.name: Uniqueness
entries: 下列數據為六隻上古恐龍所共有：{@creature Elder Dinosaur (Etali, Primal Storm)|PSX|Etali, Primal Storm}、{@creature Elder Dinosaur (Ghalta, Primal Hunger)|PSX|Ghalta, Primal Hunger}、{@creature Elder Dinosaur (Nezahal, Primal Tide)|PSX|Nezahal, Primal Tide}、{@creature Elder Dinosaur (Tetzimoc, Primal Death)|PSX|Tetzimoc, Primal Death}、{@creature Elder Dinosaur (Zacama, Primal Calamity)|PSX|Zacama, Primal Calamity}、{@creature Elder Dinosaur (Zetalpa, Primal Dawn)|PSX|Zetalpa, Primal Dawn}

action.name: Frightful Presence
entries: 上古恐龍 120 呎內由它選擇且察覺到它的每個生物，必須成功通過一次 {@dc 17} 感知豁免檢定，否則{@condition frightened||恐懼} 1 分鐘。生物可以在它每個回合結束時重複豁免檢定（若上古恐龍在其視線內則具有劣勢），成功則結束自己身上的效應。若生物豁免成功或該效應對它結束，該生物在接下來 24 小時內免疫上古恐龍的「駭人威儀」。

action.name: Swallow
entries: 上古恐龍對一個被它擒抱的大型或更小生物進行一次啃咬攻擊。若攻擊命中，該生物受到啃咬的傷害，目標被吞下，擒抱隨之結束。被吞下期間，該生物處於{@condition blinded||目盲}與{@condition restrained||束縛}狀態，對上古恐龍體外的攻擊與其他效應具有{@quickref Cover||3||全掩護}，並在上古恐龍的每個回合開始時受到 56（{@damage 16d6}）酸蝕傷害。若上古恐龍在單一回合內受到體內生物造成的 60 點或更多傷害，它必須在該回合結束時成功通過一次 {@dc 20} 體質豁免檢定，否則吐出所有被吞下的生物，這些生物以{@condition prone||伏地}狀態落在它 10 呎內的空間。若上古恐龍死亡，被吞下的生物不再被它{@condition restrained||束縛}，並可以花費 20 呎移動力從屍體中脫出，脫出時處於{@condition prone||伏地}狀態。

legendary.name: Attack
entries: 上古恐龍進行一次爪擊、尾擊、翼擊或鰭擊攻擊。

legendary.name: Move
entries: 上古恐龍移動至多其速度的一半。

legendary.name: Chomp (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: 上古恐龍進行一次啃咬攻擊，或使用「吞嚥」。

monster.name: Elder Dinosaur (Etali, Primal Storm)

items.name: Lightning Storm
entries: The elder dinosaur is always accompanied by a raging thunderstorm similar to the effect of a {@spell call lightning} spell. A storm cloud in the shape of a cylinder that is 10 feet tall with a 60-foot radius instantly forms 100 feet in the air over the elder dinosaur when it is angered or becomes violent, as long as it is outdoors. On each of its turns, as an action, the elder dinosaur can choose a point it can see within 120 feet of it. A bolt of lightning flashes down from the cloud to that point. Each creature within 10 feet of that point must make a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw, taking 21 ({@damage 6d6}) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

items.name: Multiattack
entries: The elder dinosaur can use its Frightful Presence and call down two lightning strikes from its Lightning Storm. It then makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

items.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 19} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}36 ({@damage 4d12 + 10}) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 20}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, and the elder dinosaur can't bite another target.

items.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 19} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}28 ({@damage 4d8 + 10}) slashing damage.

items.name: Spiny Carapace
entries: The elder dinosaur is covered in an armored carapace bristling with thick, sharp spines. Any creature that hits or misses Tetzimoc with a melee attack takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) piercing damage.

items.name: Tail Spike Regrowth
entries: The elder dinosaur has forty tail spikes. Used spikes regrow when the elder dinosaur finishes a long rest.

items.name: Multiattack
entries: The elder dinosaur can use its Frightful Presence. It then makes five attacks: one with its bite, two with its claws, one with its horns, and one with its tail. It can use its tail spikes in place of any or all of those attacks, and it can use its Swallow instead of its bite.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: 褶傘吐殺龍進行三次攻擊：一次啃咬，以及兩次爪擊。

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} 命中 {@hit 5}，觸及 5 呎，單一目標。{@h}6（{@damage 1d6 + 3}）穿刺傷害。

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} 命中 {@hit 5}，觸及 5 呎，單一目標。{@h}6（{@damage 1d6 + 3}）劈砍傷害。

action.name: Spit Poison
entries: {@atk rw} 命中 {@hit 5}，射程 15/30 呎，單一生物。{@h}目標必須進行一次 {@dc 13} 體質豁免檢定，豁免失敗受到 18（{@damage 4d8}）毒素傷害，成功則傷害減半。此外，豁免失敗的生物陷入{@condition blinded||目盲}狀態直到褶傘吐殺龍的下個回合結束。

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: 若基沙斯豁免檢定失敗，它可以選擇改為成功。

action.name: Multiattack
entries: 基沙斯進行兩次攻擊：一次啃咬，一次踐踏或尾擊。它不能以這兩次攻擊攻擊同一個目標。

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} 命中 {@hit 11}，觸及 15 呎，單一目標。{@h}39（{@damage 5d12 + 7}）穿刺傷害。若目標是大型或更小的生物，它必須成功通過一次 {@dc 19} 敏捷豁免檢定，否則陷入{@condition grappled||被擒}狀態（脫逃 {@dc 19}）。直到擒抱結束前，目標陷入{@condition restrained||束縛}狀態，且基沙斯不能啃咬其他目標。

action.name: Swallow
entries: 基沙斯對一個被它擒抱的大型或更小生物進行一次啃咬攻擊。若攻擊命中，該生物受到啃咬的傷害並被吞下，擒抱隨之結束。被吞下期間，該生物處於{@condition blinded||目盲}與{@condition restrained||束縛}狀態，對基沙斯體外的攻擊與其他效應具有{@quickref Cover||3||全掩護}，並在基沙斯每個回合開始時受到 21（{@damage 6d6}）酸蝕傷害。

若基沙斯在單一回合內受到體內生物造成的 30 點或更多傷害，它必須在該回合結束時成功通過一次 {@dc 18} 體質豁免檢定，否則吐出所有被吞下的生物，這些生物以{@condition prone||伏地}狀態落在它 10 呎內的空間。若基沙斯死亡，被吞下的生物不再被它{@condition restrained||束縛}，並可花費 20 呎移動力從屍體中脫身，離開時處於{@condition prone||伏地}狀態。

action.name: Stomp
entries: {@atk mw} 命中 {@hit 11}，觸及 10 呎，單一目標。{@h}29（{@damage 5d8 + 7}）鈍擊傷害，且目標必須成功通過一次 {@dc 19} 力量豁免檢定，否則被擊倒而{@condition prone||伏地}。

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} 命中 {@hit 11}，觸及 15 呎，單一目標。{@h}25（{@damage 4d8 + 7}）鈍擊傷害。

legendary.name: Attack
entries: 基沙斯進行一次踐踏或尾擊攻擊。

legendary.name: Roar (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: 基沙斯 120 呎內每個能聽見它的生物必須成功通過一次 {@dc 19} 感知豁免檢定，否則陷入{@condition frightened||恐懼}狀態 1 分鐘。生物可以在它每個回合結束時重新進行豁免檢定，成功則結束自身所受的效應。若一個生物豁免成功或其身上的效應結束，該生物在接下來 24 小時內免疫基沙斯的咆哮。

items.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d4 + 1}) slashing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw or contract a disease. Until the disease is cured, the target can't regain hit points except by magical means, and the target's hit point maximum decreases by 3 ({@dice 1d6}) every 24 hours. If the target's hit point maximum drops to 0 as a result of this disease, the target dies.

items.name: Multiattack
entries: The harpy makes two attacks: one with its claws and one with its bite.

monster.name: Sunbird
languages: understands Common but can't speak it

trait.name: Death Throes
entries: 太陽鳥死亡時會爆炸，它 30 呎內的每個生物必須進行一次 {@dc 18} 敏捷豁免檢定，豁免失敗受到 42（{@damage 12d6}）火焰傷害，成功則傷害減半。爆炸會點燃該區域內未被穿戴或攜帶的可燃物件。太陽鳥的身體化為灰燼，但在太陽鳥原本所在之處留下一顆蛋。

trait.name: Fire Aura
entries: 在太陽鳥每個回合開始時，它 5 呎內的每個生物受到 11（{@damage 2d10}）火焰傷害，且該區域內未被穿戴或攜帶的可燃物件會著火。觸碰太陽鳥或在其 5 呎內以近戰攻擊命中它的生物受到 11（{@damage 2d10}）火焰傷害。這道靈光還會散發半徑 60 呎的明亮光照，並向外再延伸 60 呎的微光。

trait.name: Flyby
entries: 太陽鳥飛出敵人的觸及範圍時不會引發藉機攻擊。

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Sight
entries: 太陽鳥在依賴聽覺或視覺的感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定上具有優勢。

action.name: Multiattack
entries: 太陽鳥進行兩次利爪攻擊。

action.name: Talon
entries: {@atk mw} 命中 {@hit 14}，觸及 5 呎，單一目標。{@h}16（{@damage 2d6 + 9}）劈砍傷害外加 14（{@damage 4d6}）火焰傷害，且目標陷入{@condition grappled||被擒}狀態（脫逃 {@dc 18}）。直到擒抱結束前，目標陷入{@condition restrained||束縛}狀態，且太陽鳥不能用那隻爪子攻擊其他目標。被{@condition grappled||擒抱}的生物在太陽鳥每個回合開始時受到 11（{@damage 2d10}）火焰傷害。
